acceptance.anisotropic_branch_A: At least one frozen paired-cycle determinant is nonzero modulo a declared prime, with every declared point replayed over both primes; this proves nonidentity over Z[tx,ty,tz].
acceptance.branch_B: All cheap-gate values zero triggers symbolic elimination or exact interpolation. No finite zero sample is promoted to polynomial identity.
acceptance.isotropic_branch_A: At least one frozen paired-cycle determinant is nonzero modulo a declared prime, with every declared point replayed over both primes; this proves nonidentity over Z[t].

author: Hainan Zhao

claim_templates.anisotropic_nonzero: PROVED: for G_(10,3), the frozen paired-cycle minor is nonzero on a nonempty Zariski-open subset of the homogeneous anisotropic locus; hence generic canonical rank is 256 there.
claim_templates.isotropic_nonzero: PROVED: for G_(10,3), the frozen paired-cycle minor is nonzero on the isotropic line outside the finite algebraic exceptional set E={t:D_iso(t)=0}; no nonvanishing at every physical temperature is claimed.
claim_templates.restriction_zero: PROVED only after symbolic closure: the named frozen minor lies in the vanishing ideal of the stated homogeneous restriction. This is a witness separation, not rank deficiency, unless all maximal minors are shown to vanish.

decision_question: Does the Cycle 8 frozen 256x256 paired-cycle minor remain a nonzero polynomial on the homogeneous anisotropic and isotropic width-three loci?

fixed_cut.row_and_column_rule: Exactly the Cycle 8 paired-cycle character sets from the frozen tree, chords, and selected dual coordinates; no post-specialization pivot selection.

interpolation_branch.anisotropic_rule: Do not launch the full Cartesian grid automatically. First seek exact symbolic factorization or a proved lower-degree/sparsity bound; absent such a reduction, classify the frozen-minor identity question unresolved rather than infer identity from samples.
interpolation_branch.isotropic_rule: Degree <=51456, so 51457 exact distinct evaluations determine D_iso(t). Use an earlier stopping rule only after a proved degree reduction or symbolic factorization.
interpolation_branch.root_set_rule: If D_iso is nonzero, the only excluded physical values are the finite algebraic set E=D_iso^{-1}(0) intersect (0,1), of cardinality at most 51456. State 'outside a finite exceptional set', never 'all temperatures'.

kill_criteria: A mismatch in the canonical tensor hash or full-rank profile at the previously certified controls anisotropic (2,3,5) or isotropic t=2 kills the implementation; vanishing of this preselected minor alone does not.
If the frozen minor vanishes but a different minor is full rank, preserve the witness failure and do not silently change rows.
All fixed evaluations zero do not prove polynomial identity.
